messages:
elaine: dropping a focused thread for the observability console slice. Key customer asks: clear per-route cost breakdown, a lightweight trace hook to link into tracing backends, and improved error grouping to cut noise. Need to pick scope for the next sprint.

matt: I sketched three options: "Baseline"=dashboards + rough cost estimates; "Link"=dashboards + trace hook API + grouping; "Complete"=everything incl. per-tenant billing and span viewer. My vote: Link.

diego: Link is reasonable. It delivers the things customers keep asking for without committing to full billing infra. We should lock acceptance criteria before dev starts.

elsoph: acceptance criteria proposal: dashboards up in prod, cost widget shows route+model breakdown with a confidence band, trace hook API documented + SDK snippet, error grouping reduces alert noise by >=50% in canary.

elaine: telemetry guardrail: default sampling 0.5% global. Dedicated tenants can increase sampling via console up to 5%. UI should show an "Estimated token delta" before they enable higher sampling.

matt: runtime task: attach minimal metadata per request: {route, model, tokens_in, tokens_out} and set header when sampled. Pseudocode: ```if(sampled){ response.setHeader('x-rw-span', spanId); emitMetric('trace.forward', {route}) }```

diego: cost attribution plan: nightly aggregation for launch, labeled "best-effort". UI shows a confidence band and an info tooltip explaining multi-model limitations. Cap raw telemetry retention to 7 days to limit cost.

soph: canary plan: 6 customers for 14 days (3 PLG, 2 mid-market, 1 Dedicated). Monitor: token delta, dashboard query latency, false-positive error groups. Abort if token delta > 35% or p95 query latency > 250ms.

elaine: owners: Product=elaine, Runtime=matt, Platform=diego, Docs=soph. canary-bot will post canary health. Dev estimates: schema changes (1d), trace hook + SDK (2d), cost aggregation + dashboard (3d), error grouping + tests (2d) => ~8 engineer-days in parallel.

matt: dependency: runtime must expose token counts reliably. I'll open a telemetry PR today and coordinate with infra on retention.

diego: UX note: keep the cost widget simple initially — stacked bars per-route with a small confidence ribbon. No per-span UI in v1; just an external trace link when span-id is present.

soph: Docs note: draft copy should include the canary plan, guardrails, and an FAQ entry: "Why are these numbers approximate?". I'll start the doc and add examples.

elaine: decision: go with "Link" scope. Actions: matt open telemetry PR; diego create dashboard tickets; soph draft UI copy and canary runbook. Please react here to confirm.

matt: :thumbsup:

diego: :thumbsup:

soph: :thumbsup:

canary-bot: CANARY SCHEDULED start=1750170000 duration=14d. Will post daily token-delta and latency checks.

elaine: thanks everyone. Parking lot: per-tenant billing UI and full-span viewer for a future release.
